claims.text: OpenAI released o3 and o4-mini on April 16, 2025 [Source: ev-1].

claims.text: The launch signaled a shift in frontier reasoning models toward integrating vision directly into the model architecture rather than bolting it on, as well as incorporating native tool use (such as web search and code interpreter) trained into the model itself [Source: ev-1].

Additionally, OpenAI introduced "budget forcing," a technique using a fixed maximum thought budget with dynamic compute that allows harder questions to think longer, alongside its first private chain-of-thought policy where reasoning tokens are not exposed to API callers [Source: ev-1].

claims.text: Strategically, with GPT-5 not yet shipping, OpenAI used this release to defend the reasoning-model frontier against cost shocks from DeepSeek's R1 and agentic-coding pushes by Anthropic [Source: ev-1].
